subject: Partner request — CloudResell promotional credits & trial extension for Acuity Health
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna.park@cloudresell.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv@si-partners.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credits + 90d trial extension request for Acuity Health

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acuity Health (pilot) loved the latency profile and integration hooks. We have a short window to capture them as a customer and would like to request partner-sourced promotional credits so they can continue the pilot while procurement finalizes the PO.

Details:
- Customer: Acuity Health (pilot, 3 engineers + 2 data scientists)
- Current trial ends: 2026-03-16
- Request: 90-day extension + $12,000 in promotional credits (to be consumed via AWS Marketplace billing)
- Why: SI lead (Rajiv) confirmed a procurement hold until 4/20; credits keep the pilot active so they don’t fragment evaluation.

Attached is a draft SOW & brief statement of work for the pilot so you can see expected usage patterns. Can Redwood accept credits routed via AWS Marketplace (we can issue a voucher ID) or do you need a different flow?

Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Thanks,
Anna Park
Partnerships — CloudResell
anna.park@cloudresell.io | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudResell_SOW_draft.docx
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Anna Park <anna.park@cloudresell.io>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits + 90d trial extension request for Acuity Health

Anna — thanks for the context and the SOW. This is the sort of partner-sourced arrangement we can support, but we need to confirm a couple of items before I can approve anything: 

1) Billing flow: if CloudResell issues an AWS Marketplace voucher, we need the voucher code and issuance date so Sales Ops can map consumption against the voucher.
2) Legal/TOS: we require a partner promo terms doc — transferability and expiration clauses are important.
3) Cap: I can provision up to $10k in credits via our partner promo program with Sales Ops sign-off; anything above that needs director approval (Marcus).

Steph — looping you for process + to confirm what we need from Marketplace/legal to actually provision credits and extend the trial window on our side. Marcus — tagging you because the partner asked for $12k; if we can accept $10k now and CloudResell covers the remainder that may be the fastest path.

Two quick questions for Anna (cc Rajiv): can you confirm the expected monthly token consumption estimate for the pilot? That will determine how far $10k lasts.

I attached the internal promo approval form so Steph can fill it out with the marketplace voucher and associated doc links.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Sales Director — Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (650) 999-2010

Attachments: SRV_Promo_approval_form.xlsx
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, Anna Park <anna.park@cloudresell.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits + 90d trial extension request for Acuity Health

Thanks — I reviewed the draft SOW and spoke with Billing. Process notes below: 

- We can provision partner-funded promotional credits that consume against a Marketplace voucher ID. To proceed we need: voucher ID, voucher issuance date, and the voucher terms (CR_Promo_TOS.pdf).
- Approval threshold: Sales Ops can approve up to $10,000 in credits for pilot extensions without director sign-off; Marcus will need to approve anything larger.
- Trial extension: once voucher is validated we can extend the trial window by 90 days on the tenant; please confirm the tenant ID or primary project name so we update the right account.
- Consumption reporting: credits will appear as a credit line on the customer's Marketplace invoice; we will not back-bill Redwood usage to CloudResell — voucher must be redeemable at time of consumption.

If you can provide the voucher and a signed SOW (CloudResell_SOW_signed.pdf) we will: 1) validate voucher with Marketplace, 2) provision $10k partner credits to the Acuity Health trial, and 3) extend the trial expiry to 2026-06-14. For any remaining gap (you asked $12k) we can either revisit with Marcus for director approval or CloudResell can cover the $2k bridge.

I'll attach the standard partner promo terms (CR_Promo_TOS.pdf) and mark this as urgent — I can process the voucher validation within one business day after we receive docs.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Sergio / Steph — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Steph's checklist attached are the items: 

- Signed SOW: CloudResell_SOW_signed.pdf (attached)
- Voucher ID: AWS-VCHR-2026-03-ACUITY-77 (valid from 2026-03-10 to 2026-06-30)
- Voucher terms: uploaded and attached (CR_Promo_TOS.pdf)
- Tenant: Acuity-Prod-Project (Acuity Health evaluation tenant)

Rajiv (cc) confirmed CloudResell will cover any shortfall beyond $10k if Redwood cannot approve the extra $2k immediately. If Marcus needs to approve the extra, please let us know and we'll route the approval.

We'd like the trial extension to be active before Monday 3/15 if possible. Please confirm next steps and ETA.

Thanks —
Anna
